#!/bin/bash
# The first-boot questions, read from an Armbian 26.05 image's /usr/lib/armbian/armbian-firstlogin.
# Only the preset names this box relies on are kept, in the order the file reads them.
if [[ -f /root/.not_logged_in_yet ]]; then
	source /root/.not_logged_in_yet
fi

if [[ -n "${PRESET_ROOT_PASSWORD}" ]]; then
	echo "root:${PRESET_ROOT_PASSWORD}" | chpasswd
fi
if [[ -n "${PRESET_USER_NAME}" ]]; then
	useradd -m -s "${PRESET_USER_SHELL}" -c "${PRESET_DEFAULT_REALNAME}" "${PRESET_USER_NAME}"
	echo "${PRESET_USER_NAME}:${PRESET_USER_PASSWORD}" | chpasswd
fi
if [[ "${PRESET_CONNECT_WIRELESS}" == "yes" ]]; then
	nmcli dev wifi connect "${PRESET_NET_WIFI_SSID}" password "${PRESET_NET_WIFI_KEY}"
fi
